business_problem: the Industrial Resilience Research Group needed to trace complex global supply chains and detect emerging disruptions, but public reports, satellite imagery, and news data were too voluminous for academic tools and limited local computing.
solution_summary: University of Cambridge uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: the Industrial Resilience Research Group needed to trace complex global supply chains and detect emerging disruptions, but public reports, satellite imagery, and news data were too voluminous for academic tools and limited local computing. Cloud Storage stores the raw public reports, satellite imagery references, and news data that feed the observatory, serving as the storage layer. BigQuery organizes and prepares the collected data so analysts can query and model supply-chain behavior at scale, serving as the storage layer. Gemini processes and cleans incoming data while also supporting sentiment analysis over supply-chain vulnerability signals, serving as the compute layer. Vertex AI classifies the curated data for forecasting and downstream risk analysis, serving as the compute layer.
